access.dashboardNote: Choose what this role sees on the dashboard. This doesn't hide data — use Permissions and Data access for that.

deals.title: Currency
deals.description: The currency used for new deals and for pipeline and dashboard totals.
deals.defaultCurrencyDesc: New deals default to this currency, and pipeline and dashboard totals are shown in it. Existing deals keep the currency they were saved with.
deals.adminOnlyHint: Only account admins can change the default currency.

Settings.readOnly: You can see this section but not change it. Ask an admin for the Write tick in Access control.

clinic.title: [[Business]]
clinic.description: Opening hours, holidays and days the [[business]] is closed. [[Bookings]] and the WhatsApp booking assistant only offer times when the [[business]] is open.
clinic.hoursHint: Switch a day off to close the [[business]] every week on that day.
clinic.copyMonday: Copy Monday to all open days
clinic.endBeforeStart: Closing time must be after opening time
clinic.holidaysHint: Days off. Turn on Every year for holidays on the same date each year.
clinic.closuresHint: One-off closed periods, such as renovation or staff training. Both dates are included.
clinic.saveDesc: New [[bookings]] and the booking assistant use these hours and closed days straight away. Existing [[bookings]] aren't moved.
clinic.notReady: [[Business]] settings need migration 060_clinic_settings.sql. Until it's run, the default hours (Monday–Saturday 9:00–18:00) are used and changes can't be saved.
clinic.closedNotice: The [[business]] is closed on this day ({why}). You can still enter a custom time.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.description: Let an AI answer WhatsApp chats that are switched to Bot. It answers only from your [[business]]'s details and hands the chat to staff when it doesn't know.
ai.activeHint: When off, no chat gets AI replies, whatever its switch says.
ai.newChatsBot: New chats start in Bot mode
ai.newChatsBotHint: Otherwise every chat starts as Human and staff switch it to Bot in the inbox.
ai.keySaved: Saved — leave blank to keep it
ai.keyHint: Your own key, stored encrypted. Usage is billed by the provider to you.
ai.keyNeeded: Add the API key before switching the assistant on.
ai.knowledgeHint: It already knows your [[business]] name, opening hours, holidays, services and [[staffs]]. Add anything else [[customers]] ask about: fees, payment, parking, preparation, tone.
ai.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. A standard visit costs ₹500. We accept UPI and cards. Free parking behind the building. Be friendly and brief.
ai.handoffHint: The chat switches to Human, is assigned to this person and they get a notification. The [[customer]] is told a team member will reply.
ai.handoffAssigned: Whoever the chat is assigned to
ai.maxReplies: AI replies per chat before handing over
ai.saveDesc: Chats in Bot mode use the new settings from the next message.
ai.baseUrlHint: Where your Ollama server answers, as seen from this app's server, e.g. http://localhost:11434 or http://192.168.1.20:11434. Pull the model on that server first (ollama pull llama3.2).
ai.keyHintLocal: Only needed if your server sits behind a proxy that asks for one. Stored encrypted.

business.title: Business type
business.description: What you call your business, customers, staff and bookings. Every screen, the WhatsApp booking replies and the AI assistant use these words.
business.sectorHint: Pick the closest one. It fills in the words below, which you can then change.
business.wordsHint: Leave a box empty to use the word shown in grey.
business.saveDesc: Every screen, the WhatsApp booking replies and the AI assistant start using these words straight away. Messages already sent are not changed.
business.notReady: Business type needs migration 064_vocabulary_and_layouts.sql. Until it's run, the default words are used and changes can't be saved.
business.readOnly: Only the owners and admins of the main account can change the business type.

dashboardCards.title: Dashboard
dashboardCards.description: The template new users start from, and the name and icon of every dashboard card. Each user can still arrange their own dashboard.
dashboardCards.defaultTemplateHint: Users who haven't arranged their dashboard see this one. It doesn't change anyone's saved layout.
dashboardCards.cardsHint: Leave a name empty to use the default shown in grey.
dashboardCards.notReady: Dashboard settings need migration 064_vocabulary_and_layouts.sql. Until it's run, the default names are used and changes can't be saved.
dashboardCards.readOnly: Only the owners and admins of the main account can change these.

Booking.title: Booking assistant
Booking.cardDesc: A ready-made WhatsApp bot that books [[bookings]] and shows free times. Bookings appear in [[Bookings]] and on the dashboard.
Booking.subtitle: Customers send a trigger word, then choose Book [[booking]] or Check availability. The bot asks for the service, [[staff]], day and a free time, the [[customer]]'s name and your own questions, shows a summary to confirm, and books it. Bookings appear in [[Bookings]] and on the dashboard as "via WhatsApp".
Booking.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them. Changing them needs Edit on Automations.
Booking.confirmOn: It will answer customers who send a trigger word from now on.
Booking.confirmOff: It is switched off, so it won't answer anyone.
Booking.needKeyword: Add at least one trigger word.
Booking.badHours: {day}: closing time must be after opening time.
Booking.onDesc: On — customers who send a trigger word are answered by the bot.
Booking.offDesc: Off — switch it on to start answering customers.
Booking.keywordsHint: Separate with commas. A message containing one of these words (e.g. "I want to book") starts the assistant. Customers can type CANCEL any time to stop.
Booking.hoursDesc: Only times inside these hours are offered. [[a:Staff]]'s existing [[bookings]] are skipped automatically.
Booking.slotMinutesHint: e.g. 30 offers 9:00, 9:30, 10:00… The service's own length decides how long it takes.
Booking.daysAheadHint: How far ahead customers can book, today included.
Booking.minNoticeHint: Times sooner than this are not offered.
Booking.questionsDesc: Asked in this order where "Your questions" sits in the steps. Answers are saved in the [[booking]]'s notes.
Booking.questionPlaceholder: e.g. Is this your first visit?
Booking.cancelWordsHint: Separate with commas. If the customer's whole message is one of these, the assistant stops. Leave empty to only stop with the Cancel button.
Booking.stepsDesc: Switch steps on or off and drag them into the order you want. The preview updates as you go.
Booking.offerCheckHint: Shows Book [[booking]] / Check availability buttons first. Off: the assistant goes straight into booking.

stepsHint.service: Pick from Master → Services. Skipped when you have only one.
stepsHint.doctor: Pick [[a:staff]] or "any available". Off: any free [[staff]] is given.
stepsHint.datetime: Pick a day, then a free time. Always on.
stepsHint.name: Only asked when the contact has no name; saved on the contact.
stepsHint.questions: The questions below, in their order.

Booking.beforeDatetime: Stays before date & time, because the free times depend on it.
Booking.stepsOrderFixed: Service and [[staff]] have to come before date & time, so the order was adjusted.
Booking.defaultService: Service name when the service step is off
Booking.defaultServiceHint: Saved on the [[booking]]. The slot length is used as its duration.
Booking.confirmStepHint: Customers see the details with Confirm / Change / Cancel. Off: it books as soon as the last step is answered.
Booking.textsDesc: Every word the customer sees, so you can write in your own style or language. WhatsApp limits buttons to 20 characters and list rows to 24.

texts.pleaseChoose: When the answer isn't one of the options

preview.title: Live preview
preview.hint: Tap the buttons to try it. Nothing is sent or saved; existing [[bookings]] are ignored.

Layout.presetSavedTable: Saved as your preset for this table
